cases_used.symptom: which nvcc -> /usr/local/corex/bin/nvcc is a #!/bin/bash script (prints an nvcc banner, produces no objects); CMake ENABLE_LANGUAGE(CUDA) fails with 'Failed to extract nvcc implicit link line'.
cases_used.applied: Did not create a dummy nvcc / did not use the stub as CUDA compiler. Detected the CoreX toolkit in cmake/cuda.cmake and pointed CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER at clang++ (ID=ILUVATAR).

cases_used.symptom: How a standard CMake `LANGUAGES CUDA` project maps onto CoreX (clang++ -x ivcore, CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER_ID=ILUVATAR, CUDAToolkit reports 10.2 but clang is 22.x).
cases_used.applied: Relied on CoreX auto-detection of clang++ as the CUDA compiler after removing the forced nvcc; set CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=ivcore11.

cases_used.symptom: nvcc-only flags / NVIDIA sm_XX arch numbers are rejected or ignored by the CoreX clang backend.
cases_used.applied: Set target CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=ivcore11 for ILUVATAR; guarded -Werror=cross-execution-space-call so it is not passed to CoreX clang.

cases_used.symptom: Host-side bare min()/max() -> 'no matching function for call to max' under CoreX clang++ (only __device__ overloads visible; nvcc's GCC host path exposes global min/max).
cases_used.applied: Included <algorithm> and used std::max in source/device/cuda/op/nvgpu_softmax.cu (host code path).

cases_checked_not_hit: double-degraded-fp32 / double-cmath-broken (no device double arithmetic in the CUDA ops; only a commented-out host double timing line)
texture-software-bridge (no texture<>/tex1D/tex2D usage in the CUDA backend)
um-to-malloc (backend uses explicit cudaMalloc + cudaMemcpy, no cudaMallocManaged)
atomics-broken (no u64/double atomics in the ops)
warp32-to-warp64 (softmax reduction uses __shared__ block reduction, no warp-shuffle assumptions that break)
